rationale: Statins have no pancreatic mechanism - pancreatitis is a GLP-1 and gallstone association
Fluoroquinolones have no hair-loss mechanism - alopecia is a chemotherapy and retinoid effect
No known mechanism linking GLP-1 agonists to skeletal muscle breakdown
Anticoagulants have no CNS mechanism for mood disorders
MTX is an antimetabolite with no CNS sleep-wake mechanism
